nom: Lancôme Tonique Douceur Alcohol Free Toner

segments.oily: Several reviewers with oily or oily/acne-prone skin report the toner removes excess oil and leaves skin balanced without feeling greasy, though one oily-skin reviewer notes the hydration may be too much for that skin type.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the toner does not dry out or strip the skin, leaving it soft and hydrated even in cold weather.
segments.combination: One reviewer expects combination skin to do well with this toner mainly because it is alcohol-free, though this is a prediction rather than a direct report.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several say it does not irritate them and is gentle even around the eyes, while others report burning, redness, small bumps, or had to return it due to fragrance or the benzyl alcohol content.
segments.mature: An older reviewer (76) and another in her fifties describe it as a longtime staple that suits mature skin, with one crediting it with minimizing fine lines versus alcohol-based toners.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal-to-oily skin reports no reactions and a clean, hydrated feel.

concerns.aging: One 50-year-old reviewer reports fine lines minimized after switching from an alcoholic toner; this is a single, self-reported observation rather than a broad pattern.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers across skin types report the toner leaves skin soft, hydrated, and never stripped or dry, including in winter conditions; no reviewer reports it causing dryness.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports red little bumps appearing after use; most other reviewers do not mention redness.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer states the product flared up her eczema and identifies benzyl alcohol in the ingredients as the likely cause; no other reviewer links the product to barrier issues.
concerns.spots: Reviewers with cystic or teenage acne report favorable results, with breakouts happening less often and skin feeling clearer; however, other acne-prone reviewers report the product caused breakouts and one says all Lancôme products break her out.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report fewer breakouts and clearer skin over time; at the same time, multiple 1-2 star reviews describe new breakouts, small pimples, or breakouts all over the face after use.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report the toner controls excess oil and leaves a natural glow without greasiness, though one notes the formula's hydration might be excessive for very oily skin.

aspects.libelle: High price point relative to formula

extraits.texte: I checked the ingredients after I caused my eczema to flair up and it states "benzyl alcohol" on the bottle... pretty disappointed because I love Lancôme products
I had to return it because of high perfume smell. Not good for my sensitive skin

I bought this on a whim as I wanted to try Lancome products. Turns out I did not like any of their moisturizers but this toner is something else. I use it at night before I apply my moisturizer and the result has been amazing. It cleanses well and moisturizes my skin, makes it look soft and brightens my complexion. I have sensitive skin but this did not irritate my skin and I use this toner combined with a different brand moisturizer which seem to work great. I am a 50 year old lady and the fine lines on my face have been minimized as well. Just remember ladies alcoholic toners ages you, so try this one and you will be happy!

I love this toner! I am 18 years old and still have my teenage acne prone skin. I save every penny in order to buy this toner everytime. I have extremely oily skin and this toner is just the right amount of moisture my skin needs without breaking me out! I can definately see people with dry or combination skin loving this product just because it doesn't contain alcohol. I apply mine on a cotton round right after I wash my face both day and night. The only con I have for this is the packaging. It is beautiful packaging but the hole that distributes product is quite big so when you go to putting it on the cotton round, if you aren't careful it will distribute too much product and you might end up wasting too much of it. Overall, if you are skeptical of trying this toner out, I say give it a try!

I have struggled with cystic acne for a long time. I have oily skin that is very sensitive. No other toner I have ever used has been this great. In the morning, I now skip using a stripping cleanser and use this instead. My skin has never been better. Breakouts happen less often and my skin always feels hydrated after using this.
So disappointed. Used it for a week as instructed and it caused small breakouts all over my face.

Bought this last year, used a few times and it didnt do anything good. It broke me out a little bit and I returned it. Everything by Lancome makes me breakout, I'm acne prone so if you are too ide be careful. There are better options out there with better ingredients. Trust me on that.
